title: Audit P104 relay composition and later-read departure floor
body:
The P104 relay discussion proposes a 208-helper departure floor while identifying 336 demands accessible through later source frames. This package proves the missing implication for the stated frozen-path, X-only monotone network class: after removing all potentially later-readable demands, each source's forced target hyperplanes still intersect in its initial line. Two departures per distinct source line are therefore necessary, even with rational mixing and cancellation. The numerical 208 bound and the 336 entries are credited predecessor results; this does not strengthen the numerical floor.

It also independently composes Philippe Van Velzen's pinned 1,031-helper relay-v2 with the complete original P104 channel. Separate rational forward and exact dyadic reverse interpreters check all 1,718,721 coefficients of the 1,311-input endpoint, all 21,682 chronological events, dirty-helper restoration and the 9,279 added / 11,647 combined boundary rank mass. The older 2,185-helper word is retained and fully replayed as historical evidence. PR #2594 is credited for its correction-only endpoint and logical-growth audit; no growth, arrival-shape or price-cap result is claimed here.

Validation: optimized CPython 3.12.7 replay and registered launcher passed all three test groups; a separate agent reviewed the proof and implementations and independently replayed both words on optimized CPython 3.12.14. Eight rejecting fault controls and one later-read countercontrol pass. Source hashes, Git blobs, exact receipts and Git-free export checks are included.

Base: current main `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, priority revision 4. Picker seed `296d172895dc11178a7b95219224afb7`, selected `p104-side-correction`; its first baseline command passed. TASK.json records the live handoff, update to v2, excluded active scope and final complete overlap cache of 798 open PRs and 1,252 Discussion records. Main was refreshed unchanged before submission.

Limits: logical/frame audit and a scoped all-network proof, not native/global supplier admission. The original eight nonzero private-copy erasures are explicit; new native transports, full private implementation, hosting, precision and all-size admission remain open. Credit the pinned relay author and P104 lineage. Prepared by ywz65 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance and separate agent review; no independent human or proof-assistant review is claimed.
